title: NSUK holds 8th combined convocation and 25th anniversary
summary: Over 25,000 graduates from three academic sessions were presented, including 82 first-class degrees, the Vice-Chancellor said at a press briefing.

title: Partnership to train students in furniture making
summary: An MoU with Prince Interior Vocational Institute gives students hands-on training in furniture making, interior product design and business skills.

title: One Degree, One Trade, One Enterprise initiative unveiled
summary: The university introduces an initiative aimed at transforming graduate development through skills and enterprise.
